note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS 96081019 to Saudi Arabia (BOL 1122839) and Jordan (BOL 1122302) on 2026-02-28, plus aggregated destination counters for Novorossiysk, Jebel Ali, Lat Krabang and Kathmandu. Declared HS 960810/960860 matches the observed 96081019 (ball point pens) — no HS correction needed. Domestic supply evidence could NOT be verified: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) throughout the session and zaubacorp/thecompanycheck/volza/IndiaMART all returned 403/429, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split was retrieved. Per rule 4, revenue and domestic turnover are recorded as null rather than estimated. Note the company is a pen manufacturer/exporter (writing instruments), which does not match the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' — that field is a data-entry error on the request side, not a rejection ground. No sanctions/court/ownership checks were in scope for this role. Verdict on shipments: export confirmed; domestic unverified (not 'none_found' — simply not retrievable).
